hypotheses.result: EVS map obtained; spin coherence predictions confirmed; trajectory optimization enables long-distance transport

title: All-2D vertical metal-semiconductor field-effect transistor with sub-10 nm channel and contact lengths
task: Scaling channel and contact lengths in 2D vertical metal-semiconductor FETs to sub-10 nm
key_results: Sub-10 nm channel and contact lengths; on/off ratio >10^7 at 0.5 V; SS ~62 mV/dec; on-state current density ~144 μA/μm at 1 V
comments: The vertical architecture with self-aligned Schottky junctions elegantly solves simultaneous scaling challenges, though integration complexity and yield remain to be demonstrated.

model_io.model: All-2D vertical MoS2 FET with graphene-hBN heterostructure contacts

hypotheses.hypothesis: Vertical architecture with full-gate control enables simultaneous scaling of channel and contact lengths
hypotheses.result: Lch and Lc scaled to sub-10 nm with excellent electrostatic control confirmed by TCAD

title: Multi-ion defect model for space-charge layer formation at LiPON/LixV2O5 electrochemical interfaces
task: Multi-ion defect modeling of space-charge layer formation at solid-state battery interfaces
key_results: Li-ion vacancies, Li-ion interstitials, and O-ion vacancies identified as dominant defects; electron transfer direction reverses with Li content; band-bending switches from downward (V2O5) to upward (LiV2O5, Li2V2O5)
comments: The multi-species treatment reveals transport mechanisms missed by Li-only models, with implications for battery and neuromorphic device performance.

model_io.model: LiPON/LixV2O5 (x=0,1,2) heterojunctions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Multiple ion species (Li+, O2−) and electrons participate in SCL formation, not just Li+ alone
hypotheses.result: Multi-species model predicts Li and O transfer directions; electron transfer reversal with Li content

title: A photonic integrated long-distance quantum communication network
task: Photonic integrated long-distance quantum key distribution network using twin-field protocol
key_results: Hybrid photonic transmitter chip integrating self-injection-locked laser and thin-film LN modulators; four-user spine-leaf network demonstrated over 540 km; secret key rates exceed repeaterless capacity; scalable to 50 users at metropolitan distances
comments: The photonic integration approach enables practical large-scale QKD deployment, though network latency and real-time key management remain engineering challenges.

model_io.model: Photonic integrated TF-QKD network with spine-leaf topology

hypotheses.hypothesis: Photonic integration with TF-QKD protocol enables long-distance, high-capacity quantum networks
hypotheses.result: Four-user network demonstrated over 540 km; scalability to 50 users confirmed for metropolitan QKD

title: Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells
task: Overcoming open-circuit voltage–fill-factor trade-off in organic solar cells via exciton lifetime optimization
key_results: Field-dependent free-charge generation identified as source of FF limit; Stark-effect-driven charge-transfer state energy variations quantified; long exciton lifetime shown to overcome FF limit
comments: The physics-based model elegantly explains the VOC–FF trade-off and offers practical design guidance, though experimental demonstration of the proposed solution awaits.

model_io.model: Organic solar cell with donor-acceptor heterojunction

hypotheses.hypothesis: Field-sensitive charge-transfer process due to Stark effect limits fill factor at low voltage losses
hypotheses.result: Analytical model predicts FF limit; long exciton lifetime overcomes the trade-off

title: Structural origin of line-tension reversal in nanoscale wetting of water
task: Understanding microscopic structural origin of line-tension reversal in water nanodroplet wetting
key_results: Line tension reverses sign near complete wetting due to collapse of tetrahedral order at contact line; bilayer ice forms on hydrophilic substrates but resists wetting due to structural mismatch
comments: The explicit connection between local liquid structure and wetting transitions provides mechanistic insight, though the generalizability beyond water requires further study.

model_io.model: Water nanodroplets on substrates with varying wettability

hypotheses.hypothesis: Tetrahedral order collapse at the contact line on hydrophilic surfaces drives line-tension reversal
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via MD simulations; structural mechanism identified beyond surface chemistry alone

title: Metasurface loaded multi-port tunable silicon–graphene based THz antenna with LHCP/RHCP characteristics, low-RCS and low-coupling features
task: Design of multi-port tunable THz antenna with low RCS and polarization control
key_results: MRCS reduction of ~30 dBsm; port isolation improved by 30 dB; 3-dB axial ratio bandwidth 2.65–3.15 THz
comments: The integration of metasurface-based RCS reduction with circular polarization generation is practical for THz radar applications, though experimental validation is not mentioned.

model_io.model: Silicon dielectric resonator antenna with split-ring resonator metasurface

hypotheses.hypothesis: Mirror-oriented aperture arrangement reduces port coupling
hypotheses.result: 30 dB isolation improvement achieved

title: Spatiotemporal information fusion for photon-level dynamic imaging
task: Photon-starved dynamic imaging via spatiotemporal deep learning fusion
key_results: 256×256 imaging at 200 fps with <2 photons/pixel at sampling ratio 2−9; PSNR improvement 43.12 dB over block-CS, 15.27 dB over U-Net; robust to noise, occlusion, deformation
comments: The frame-difference-aware architecture effectively enforces temporal coherence at extreme photon starvation, though applicability to truly random photon patterns requires validation.

model_io.model: PhotonST-Net: spatiotemporal reconstruction network

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temporal coherence enforcement via frame-difference awareness restores high-frequency detail at ultra-low photon counts
hypotheses.result: Superior PSNR and SSIM compared to spatial-only and conventional compressive sensing methods
